why: Connect an agent workflow to a reported deployed engine
why_cn: 把 Agent 工作流与报告中的引擎产物连接起来
boundary: Reported model + serving stack; engine source not established
boundary_cn: 报告中的模型执行与服务栈；未确认引擎源码公开
validation: Author performance/accuracy checks; experimental, no independent reproduction
validation_cn: 作者性能／准确率检查；实验性质，未独立复现

why: See how optimization choices are accepted and composed
why_cn: 了解优化配置怎样验收并组合
scope: Inspected Wan2.2-TI2V-5B path; GPU, shape and quality constraints per configuration
scope_cn: 已检查 Wan2.2-TI2V-5B 路径；GPU、形状与质量条件随配置限定
boundary: Video codebase + configuration workflow; cache / sparsity / fusion
boundary_cn: 视频代码与配置工作流；缓存／稀疏／融合
reuse: SGLang multimodal_gen; model pipelines and kernels
reuse_cn: SGLang multimodal_gen；模型流水线与内核
validation: LPIPS, visual review, engagement checks; no equivalence proof
validation_cn: LPIPS、视觉复核与优化生效检查；不是等价性证明

why: Follow an explicit task graph into persistent GPU execution
why_cn: 沿显式任务图理解持久 GPU 执行
scope: Supported LLM task graphs; NVIDIA GPU / SM allocation / topology constraints
scope_cn: 受支持的 LLM 任务图；NVIDIA GPU／SM 分配／拓扑约束
boundary: Compiled persistent program; computation + communication scheduling
boundary_cn: 编译后的持久执行程序；计算与通信调度
reuse: PyTorch tensors, CUDA, NVSHMEM, supported fused operations
reuse_cn: PyTorch 张量、CUDA、NVSHMEM 与受支持的融合算子
validation: Demos and profiling inspected; arbitrary model support not implied
validation_cn: 检查了示例与性能接口；不代表支持任意模型

why: Inspect model-shaped kernels, draft execution and serving together
why_cn: 一起查看模型专用内核、草稿执行与服务
scope: Selected Qwen3.8-27B / Qwen3.6-35B-A3B / compatible Bonsai 2; Apple M3+, macOS 26.4+
scope_cn: 选定 Qwen3.8-27B／Qwen3.6-35B-A3B／兼容 Bonsai 2；Apple M3+、macOS 26.4+
boundary: C++/Metal runtime + HTTP frontend; target/draft, state, memory policy
boundary_cn: C++/Metal 运行时与 HTTP 前端；目标／草稿执行、状态和内存策略
reuse: Checkpoints, tokenizers, Apple runtimes, llama.cpp-derived material
reuse_cn: 检查点、分词器、Apple 运行时及源于 llama.cpp 的组件
validation: Numerical/model/HTTP tests inspected, not run; kernel AI disclosure is narrower than whole-engine authorship
validation_cn: 检查但未运行数值／模型／HTTP 测试；AI 内核披露不等于整个引擎由 AI 编写

why: Study a device-focused stack with explicit per-model quality limits
why_cn: 研究设备专用栈及逐模型列明的质量边界
scope: Selected models, including reviewed Qwen3.8 Flash-Next / Qwen-Image 2.1 / H3 paths; Linux gfx1151, typically 128 GiB
scope_cn: 选定模型，包括已查 Qwen3.8 Flash-Next／Qwen-Image 2.1／H3 路径；Linux gfx1151，通常 128 GiB
boundary: C++/HIP execution, kernels, sessions and local serving
boundary_cn: C++/HIP 执行、内核、会话与本地服务
reuse: ROCm/HIP, BLAS, llama.cpp/ggml and attributed model code
reuse_cn: ROCm/HIP、BLAS、llama.cpp/ggml 与注明来源的模型代码
validation: Vision parity failure; small image coverage; full-video quality unqualified
validation_cn: 视觉一致性仍有失败；图像覆盖小；完整视频质量未完成验收

why: Separate SSD streaming from changes to the model computation
why_cn: 区分 SSD 流式读取与模型计算本身的改变
scope: Qwen3.5-397B-A17B; Apple unified memory + SSD (reported 48 GB MacBook target)
scope_cn: Qwen3.5-397B-A17B；Apple 统一内存与 SSD（报告目标为 48 GB MacBook）
boundary: C/Metal prototype; expert routing, I/O and execution
boundary_cn: C/Metal 原型；专家路由、I/O 与执行
reuse: Metal, Accelerate, dispatch, OS page cache, pretrained weights
reuse_cn: Metal、Accelerate、dispatch、系统页缓存与预训练权重
validation: K=4 versus model top-10; 2-bit JSON failures; no equivalent headline-speed comparison
validation_cn: K=4 与模型 top-10 不同；2-bit JSON 失败；头条速度不能视为等价比较

why: See what a deep fork changes and what upstream still supplies
why_cn: 了解深度分叉改了什么，又保留了哪些上游能力
scope: Qwen3.8-27B + MTP; chiefly single-stream RTX 3090 / 3090 Ti
scope_cn: Qwen3.8-27B 与 MTP；主要为单流 RTX 3090／3090 Ti
boundary: llama.cpp fork; SM86 kernels, MTP verification and KV state
boundary_cn: llama.cpp 分叉；SM86 内核、MTP 验证与 KV 状态
validation: Separate Swift checkpoint and KV changes; parallel-8 startup failure remains
validation_cn: 需区分 Swift 检查点及 KV 改变；parallel-8 启动失败仍在

why: Trace packed checkpoints into fused diffusion execution
why_cn: 从打包权重追到融合扩散执行
scope: Supported low-bit diffusion checkpoints; compatible NVIDIA GPU kernels; model names not enumerated in this record
scope_cn: 受支持的低比特扩散检查点与兼容 NVIDIA GPU 内核；本条记录未逐一列出模型名
boundary: Diffusion backend + adapters; low-bit / low-rank fused operations
boundary_cn: 扩散后端与适配器；低比特／低秩融合算子
validation: Quantization changes numerics; separate offload/cache/checkpoint effects
validation_cn: 量化改变数值；需分离卸载、缓存及检查点的影响

why_cn: 查看明确的异步权重存储契约
scope: Supported image/video models; memory-constrained accelerators and multi-device systems; models not enumerated here
scope_cn: 受支持的图像／视频模型；显存受限加速器与多设备系统；此处未逐一列出模型
boundary: Model runtime; layout planning, prefetch streams and two-slot buffers
boundary_cn: 模型运行时；布局规划、预取流与双槽缓冲
reuse_cn: PyTorch／流机制、检查点与可选内核
validation: Contiguous offload rejects graph capture/cache/multi-rank combinations; no execution here
validation_cn: 连续卸载不支持图捕获／缓存／多 rank 的相关组合；本仓库未执行

why: Follow model conversion and numerical debugging across devices
why_cn: 追踪跨设备的模型转换与数值调试
scope: Selected video models, including the reviewed Wan2.1 path; JAX/Flax TPU meshes
scope_cn: 选定视频模型，包括已查 Wan2.1 路径；JAX/Flax TPU 网格
boundary: Model port; checkpoint translation, samplers and sharding
boundary_cn: 模型移植；检查点转换、采样器与切分
reuse: JAX/Flax, Pallas, original checkpoints and references
reuse_cn: JAX/Flax、Pallas、原始检查点与参考实现
validation: Precision bugs documented; benchmark/configuration-specific evidence; TPUs not run here
validation_cn: 记录了精度错误；证据限于配置与评测；本仓库未运行 TPU

why: Read an AI disclosure beside an inspectable parity harness
why_cn: 对照 AI 开发披露与可检查的一致性测试
scope: Stable Audio 3 small/medium; CPU, optional CUDA
scope_cn: Stable Audio 3 small/medium；CPU 与可选 CUDA
boundary: Complete C audio pipeline; conditioning, diffusion, sampling, decoding
boundary_cn: 完整 C 音频流水线；条件编码、扩散、采样与解码
reuse: Released weights, vector/OpenMP facilities, optional CUDA libraries
reuse_cn: 公开权重、向量／OpenMP 机制与可选 CUDA 库
validation: Controlled reference/noise parity tests inspected, not run; quantized/steered modes need separate checks
validation_cn: 检查但未运行受控参考／噪声一致性测试；量化／引导模式需另验

why: Distinguish native action inference from robot task success
why_cn: 区分原生动作推理与机器人任务成功
scope: Selected vision-language-action policies; x86 AVX2 and ARM NEON / Apple CPU
scope_cn: 选定视觉语言动作策略；x86 AVX2 与 ARM NEON／Apple CPU
boundary: Native operators, model adapters and actions; Python robot integration outside
boundary_cn: 原生算子、模型适配与动作计算；Python 机器人集成在边界之外
reuse: Pretrained weights, GGUF conventions, architecture libraries
reuse_cn: 预训练权重、GGUF 约定与架构库
validation: Fixed-input checks; action throughput is not closed-loop frequency or robot safety
validation_cn: 固定输入检查；动作吞吐不等于闭环频率或机器人安全
